title: Verifying and Strengthening Neural Tangent Kernel Theory
abstract: arXiv:2611.27487v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Writing   Neural tangent kernel (NTK) theory explains why very wide neural networks trained by gradient methods converge in the lazy-training regime. Its standard proof combines matrix concentration, random Gram matrices, continuous-time dynamics, spectral perturbation, and a bootstrap argument, but has lacked machine-checked verification. We present a Lean\~4 formalisation for two-layer networks, proving an end-to-end theorem: for a smooth bounded activation (instantiated with $\sigma=\tanh$), frozen biases, paired $\pm 1$ initialisation, and explicit width conditions, gradient flow exists uniquely with probability at least $1-\delta$, and   $$ \|r(t)\|^2 \leq \|y\|^2 e^{-\lambda_0 t/2}. $$   The sole data assumption is population NTK non-degeneracy, $\lambda_0>0$. Initial coercivity, kernel drift, the movement bootstrap, the residual ODE, and flow existence and uniqueness are formally proved.   The formalisation also sharpens the stand

translated_title: 验证与强化神经正切核理论
translated_abstract: 神经正切核（NTK）理论解释了为什么通过梯度方法训练的超宽神经网络会在懒惰训练模式下收敛。其标准证明结合了矩阵集中不等式、随机 Gram 矩阵、连续时间动力学、谱扰动和自举论证，但一直缺乏机器可检验的验证。我们提出了针对两层网络的 Lean 4 形式化证明，证明了一个端到端定理：对于光滑有界激活函数（以 σ=tanh 实例化）、冻结偏置、成对 ±1 初始化以及显式的宽度条件，梯度流以至少 1−δ 的概率唯一存在，并且满足 ||r(t)||² ≤ ||y||² e^(−λ₀t/2)。唯一的数据假设是总体 NTK 非退化性，即 λ₀>0。初始强制性、核漂移、移动自举、残差 ODE 以及流的存在性与唯一性均得到了形式化证明。该形式化还强化了标准……
tldr: 该论文首次用 Lean 4 对两层网络的神经正切核理论进行了端到端的机器验证形式化证明，证明了梯度流的存在唯一性与残差指数收敛定理，并在此过程中强化了标准理论。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first machine-checked Lean 4 formalisation of Neural Tangent Kernel theory for two-layer networks, proving an end-to-end theorem on gradient flow existence and exponential residual convergence while strengthening the standard theory.
